params.name: statement
params.description:
Filters the transactions by statement. The available options are tenant , tenant-deposit , property-owner , 
 property-owner-consolidated , contractor , tenancy-closing-statement , late-rents , contingency-statement , invoices

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the transaction. The available options are paid , unpaid , partpaid , outstanding , or overdue . Use this parameter to filter transactions based on their payment status.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters the transactions by the date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters the transactions by the date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.
